topic: Overdraft "protection" is usually an opt-in short-term loan at an effective APR in the triple digits
title: Your Bank's Overdraft 'Protection' Is a Trap
description:
Overdraft 'protection' sounds helpful, but it's often an opt-in to an extremely expensive short-term loan. We break down the math on how a typical $35 fee can equal an APR in the thousands.
